title: Power Apps: Start SharePoint-connected canvas apps with a modern, responsive template (preview)
description: During public preview in early-release environments, the updated SharePoint/Microsoft Lists app-from-data experience gives makers responsive record browsing with grid and list views, plus separate screens for creating and editing records. It creates a standalone canvas app, not an embedded SharePoint customized form. Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.
